english.title: Taxi driver transfer to another authorised standing without consent at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the driver of a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION OF THE FIRST STANDING..) at Stansted Airport, transferred that taxi to another authorised standing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION OF THE SECOND STANDING..), without the consent of a constable or traffic warden in uniform, the Airport Company or an airport official having first been obtained
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8(7) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
